body:
These are places in the **A. P. de Zoysa** Sinhala translation of the Aṅguttara Nikāya (Fives) that look like errors, found while reading the translation beside the Pāli.

Each item gives the paragraph number and sutta heading as the file gives them, and a **fix** link that opens the line on GitHub (the pencil icon there edits it). Then: **Now** (copied from that line), **Should be**, **Why**, and lines from your own files to **compare**. If an earlier fix has moved the line, the search text finds it. Some items may be our misunderstanding; corrections are welcome. Please tick an item when it is fixed, or reply with its ID.

- [ ] **PLK-005** · paragraph 2 (චිත්ත සේඛබල සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3010.xml line 25](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L25)
  - Now: 2. චිත්ත සේඛබල සූත්‍රය
  - Should be: 2. විත්‍ථත සේඛබල සූත්‍රය
  - Why: The heading is misspelt: this is the detailed (විත්‍ථත) sutta on the trainee's powers, which explains each power, after the short one in sutta 1. Buddha Jayanthi heads it සේඛබලවිත්‍ථත, and this translation uses විත්‍ථත in the matching heading of the next chapter.
  - Compare, Pāli heading of this sutta ([an-5.json line 74](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L74)): \[සෙඛබලවිත්ථතසුත්තං\]
  - Compare, Buddha Jayanthi's Sinhala heading ([an-5.json line 167](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L167)): \[සේඛබලවිත්‍ථත සූත්‍රය\]
  - Compare, the same word in this translation, vagga\_3011.xml ([vagga_3011.xml line 47](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3011.xml#L47)): විත්‍ථත බල සූත්‍රය
  - If the line has moved, search for: `චිත්ත සේඛබල සූත්‍රය`
- [ ] **PLK-075** · paragraph 4 (යථාභතනික්ඛිත්ත සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3010.xml line 59](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L59)
  - Now: යන මේ පසිනි. මහණෙනි, මේ කරුණු පසකින් යුක්තවූ භික්‍ෂු තෙම මේ ආත්මයෙහිම පීඩා සහිතව
  - Should be: යන මේ පසිනි.” — delete the rest of this line (the closing sentence of sutta 3, “මහණෙනි, මේ කරුණු පසකින් … දුර්‍ගතියද කැමතිවිය යුතුයි.”); line 60 already gives this sutta's own closing. Then add the second half of this sutta (the heaven half) after line 60: it now stands as paragraph 5, lines 69–71 (“මහණෙනි, කරුණු පසකින් යුක්තවූ භික්‍ෂු තෙම ගෙණෙනලද බරක් බහා තබන ලද්දේ යම්සේද, මෙසේ ස්වර්‍ගයෙහි උපදී. …”).
  - Why: This sutta has two halves, the five qualities that put a monk in hell and the five that put him in heaven; paragraph 4 gives only the first, and its middle line also carries the closing sentence of sutta 3. The heaven half has slipped into paragraph 5, and from there on each paragraph holds the text of the sutta before it (see the next three items).
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta, first half ([an-5.json line 350](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L350)): යථාභතං නික්ඛිත්තො එවං නිරයෙ
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta, second half ([an-5.json line 358](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L358)): යථාභතං නික්ඛිත්තො එවං සග්ගෙ
  - Compare, the heaven half, now in paragraph 5 ([vagga_3010.xml line 69](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L69)): ගෙණෙනලද බරක් බහා තබන ලද්දේ යම්සේද, මෙසේ ස්වර්‍ගයෙහි උපදී.
  - If the line has moved, search for: `ගෙණෙනලද බරක් බිම තබන ලද්දේ යම්සේද, මෙසේ නරකයෙහි උපදී`
- [ ] **PLK-076** · paragraph 5 (සික්ඛාපච්චක්ඛාන සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3010.xml lines [69](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L69), [71](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L71)
  - Now: ගෙණෙනලද බරක් බහා තබන ලද්දේ යම්සේද, මෙසේ ස්වර්‍ගයෙහි උපදී.
  - Should be: Move lines 69–71 (the heaven half of sutta 4) up into paragraph 4, after line 60. Paragraph 5 should then hold this sutta's own text, which now stands as paragraph 6, lines 80–85 (“මහණෙනි, යම්කිසි භික්‍ෂුවක් හෝ භික්‍ෂුණියක් හෝ ශික්‍ෂාව හැරදමා ගිහිබවට පැමිණේද, …”).
  - Why: Paragraph 5, under the heading of the sutta on giving up the training, holds the second half of sutta 4 instead. This sutta's own text (the five reproaches to one who leaves the training and the five praises to one who keeps it) is in paragraph 6.
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta ([an-5.json line 377](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L377)): සික්ඛං පච්චක්ඛාය හීනායාවත්තති
  - Compare, this sutta's text, now in paragraph 6 ([vagga_3010.xml line 80](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L80)): ශික්‍ෂාව හැරදමා ගිහිබවට පැමිණේද
  - Compare, Pāli of sutta 5. 1. 1. 4., second half ([an-5.json line 358](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L358)): යථාභතං නික්ඛිත්තො එවං සග්ගෙ
  - If the line has moved, search for: `ගෙණෙනලද බරක් බහා තබන ලද්දේ යම්සේද, මෙසේ ස්වර්‍ගයෙහි උපදී`
- [ ] **PLK-077** · paragraph 6 (අකුසල සමාපත්ති සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3010.xml lines [80](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L80), [82](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L82)
  - Now: ශික්‍ෂාව හැරදමා ගිහිබවට පැමිණේද
  - Should be: Move lines 80–85 (the text of sutta 5) up into paragraph 5. Paragraph 6 should then hold this sutta's own text, which now stands at the start of paragraph 7, lines 94–96 (“මහණෙනි, යම්තාක් කුශල ධර්මයන්හි ශ්‍රද්‍ධාව එළඹ සිටියා වේද, …” to “… එකල්හි අකුශල ධර්මයාගේ පැමිණීම වේ.”).
  - Why: Paragraph 6, under the heading of the sutta on falling into the unwholesome, holds the text of sutta 5 (giving up the training). This sutta's own text (as long as faith, shame, fear of wrong, energy and wisdom are present, the unwholesome does not come in) is at the start of paragraph 7.
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta ([an-5.json line 502](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L502)): න තාව භික්ඛවෙ අකුසලස්ස සමාපත්ති හොති. යාව සද්ධා පච්චුපට්ඨිතා හොති කුසලෙසු ධම්මෙසු
  - Compare, this sutta's text, now in paragraph 7 ([vagga_3010.xml line 94](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L94)): ඒතාක් අකුශල ධර්මයට පැමිණීම නොවේ
  - Compare, Pāli of sutta 5. 1. 1. 5. ([an-5.json line 377](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L377)): සික්ඛං පච්චක්ඛාය හීනායාවත්තති
  - If the line has moved, search for: `ශික්‍ෂාව හැරදමා ගිහිබවට පැමිණේද`
- [ ] **PLK-078** · paragraph 7 (කාමපලාලිත සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3010.xml line 94](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L94)
  - Now: “මහණෙනි, යම්තාක් කුශල ධර්මයන්හි ශ්‍රද්‍ධාව එළඹ සිටියා වේද, ඒතාක් අකුශල ධර්මයට පැමිණීම නොවේ.
  - Should be: Move lines 94–96 (the text of sutta 6, from this sentence to “… දුෂ්ප්‍රඥාව හාත්පසින් වැළඳගෙන සිටීද, එකල්හි අකුශල ධර්මයාගේ පැමිණීම වේ.”) up into paragraph 6. Paragraph 7 should begin with line 97, “මහණෙනි, බොහෝ සෙයින් සත්ත්‍වයෝ කාමයන්හි ඇළුනාහු වෙත්.”
  - Why: Paragraph 7 opens with the whole text of sutta 6 before its own text on beings delighting in sense pleasures. Also, in line 95 of the moved text, shame and fear of wrong are said to be present “in unwholesome things” (අකුශල ධර්මයන්හි, twice), where the Pāli and the other three sentences have “in wholesome things” (කුශල ධර්මයන්හි).
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta ([an-5.json line 533](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L533)): යෙභුය්යෙන භික්ඛවෙ සත්තා කාමෙසු පලාළිතා
  - Compare, Pāli of sutta 5. 1. 1. 6., shame ([an-5.json line 506](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L506)): යාව හිරි පච්චුපට්ඨිතා හොති කුසලෙසු ධම්මෙසු
  - Compare, line 95 as it stands ([vagga_3010.xml line 95](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L95)): යම්තාක් අකුශල ධර්මයන්හි ලජ්ජාව එළඹ සිටියා වේද
  - If the line has moved, search for: `ඒතාක් අකුශල ධර්මයට පැමිණීම නොවේ`
- [ ] **PLK-006** · paragraph 8 (සඹම්මවචන සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3010.xml line 105](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3010.xml#L105)
  - Now: 8. සඹම්මවචන සූත්‍රය
  - Should be: 8. චවන සූත්‍රය
  - Why: The heading සඹම්මවචන is not a word and does not fit the sutta, which is about a monk who falls away (චවති) and does not stand firm in the true teaching. Buddha Jayanthi heads it චවන (falling away); probably සද්ධම්ම චවන was meant.
  - Compare, Pāli heading of this sutta ([an-5.json line 649](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L649)): \[චවනසුත්තං\]
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta ([an-5.json line 654](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L654)): භික්ඛු චවති, නප්පතිට්ඨාති සද්ධම්මෙ
  - Compare, Buddha Jayanthi's Sinhala heading ([an-5.json line 717](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L717)): චවන සූත්‍රය
  - If the line has moved, search for: `සඹම්මවචන සූත්‍රය`
- [ ] **PLK-004** · paragraph 11 (පඤ්ච තථාගත බල සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3011.xml line 2](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3011.xml#L2)
  - Now: 2. බාල වර්‍ගය
  - Should be: 2. බල වර්‍ගය
  - Why: බාල means “fool”; this chapter is on the powers (බල), as the file's own closing line and the Pāli title say.
  - Compare, closing line of this chapter ([vagga_3011.xml line 128](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3011.xml#L128)): දෙවෙනි බල වර්‍ගය නිමි.
  - Compare, Pāli title of the chapter ([an-5.json line 962](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-5.json#L962)): 2. බලවග්ගො
